data.title: bn-ccx1: SealPack is the sealed-segment default
data.description:
risk:high — failure-mode checklist required. Please answer: 1) What failure modes exist? 2) What edge cases need validation? 3) How can we roll back if this breaks? 4) What monitoring/alerts should we add? 5) What input validation is needed?

THE CHANGE. EngineOptions::seal_pack false -> true (crates/mess-store/src/engine.rs Default impl), plus its rustdoc; three loose-mode test fixtures pin seal_pack: false so loose-sidecar coverage survives; doc updates (rebuild-index help + module doc, spec 07-backup, README, owb_bench stale comment). No other production code changed — the pack write/read/refute/fallback machinery all landed in bn-3of/bn-11g/bn-30u/bn-dbz/bn-2t2e/bn-3h64/bn-1w4h.

AUTHORITY. bn-1yor's default-on scale + fault matrix (17 dimensions, ABBA) and the lead ADMIT decision recorded on that bone. Caveats C1 (fixture pins) and C2 (rebuild-index release note) are executed here; C3 (no pre-bn-dbz pack rewriter) and C4 (measurement knobs do not ship) are accepted as-is — this commit contains no env-driven default and no MESS_BENCH_SEG_MIB.

KNOWN GAP, release-noted in the commit message: mess rebuild-index is a no-op on pack-sealed segments, i.e. on every segment a current engine seals. Follow-up bone bn-3qh0.

ROLLBACK: set seal_pack: false — it stays public and fully supported, reopen dual-reads both families, and bn-11g's re_sealing_with_packs_off_leaves_the_trailer_at_eof covers the downgrade direction.

EVIDENCE. Pre-pin flipped run reproduced bn-1yor cell 1 exactly (1136 passed / 17 failed, the same 17 tests, nothing beyond). Post-pin: MESS_SNAPSHOT_LAW_ITERS=25 cargo nextest run --workspace = 1153/1153 passed, 28 skipped. cargo check --workspace --all-targets clean. just fmt-check clean. mess-bench run --mode full vs floors.json: PASS, 14/14 within tolerance.
